title: Wall Mount Shower Squeegee 15-Inch Solid Brass With Hook | Matte Gray | Allied Brass
short_title: Wall Mount Shower Squeegee 15-Inch | Allied Brass, Matte Gray
description:
Keep shower doors, tile, and mirrors clearer with quick, easy strokes using this wall mount shower squeegee crafted from solid brass in Matte Gray, which provides a sophisticated neutral that complements concrete, stone, and other modern materials.

Highlights:
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Designed to help reduce water spotting on shower doors, tile, and mirrors
- Replaceable blade for easy upkeep
- Solid brass construction for enduring everyday use
- Corrosion-free and rust-free performance from the designer finish

Specs:
- Category: Squeegee
- Overall size: 10-Inch L x 10-Inch W x 15-Inch H
- Projection: 3-Inch
- Mounting type: Wall mount
- Weight capacity: 2 lb
- Product weight: 3.2 lb
- Included: Squeegee, blade, mounting hook, and all installation hardware
- Assembly required: No
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
Style notes: Complements traditional bathroom hardware and classic bath accessories; ideal for coordinating with heritage bathroom fixtures.
